Anthropic raises $81.3 billion in record IPO

• Notable’s early Series E stake turned into a 15-fold paper gain after Anthropic’s $1.5 trillion IPO.
• Jakub Pachocki proposes using perplexity, a stable language-model metric, to set industry-wide AI development speed limits.
• AWS Quick now supports Meta ads management via natural language prompts.

items.text:
OpenAI's chief scientist wants a speed limit.

• Jakub Pachocki proposes using perplexity to cap AI progress.
• GPT-4 perplexity is 0.91; newer models drop below 0.8.
• Companies would pause development until monitoring improves.

Our read: AI development may slow down as safety standards become quantifiable.
